method: PHP token_get_all inventory of T_INC/T_DEC in sources and sources_custom PHP files excluding phpstub.php. Supplementary same-file regex shortlist pairs increment variable names with literal null/boolean/string assignments; manually inspected six resulting files. Textual shortlist is not dataflow analysis.

reviewed_candidates.disposition: All-day end_day is assigned from start_day/start_day_of_month before increment; later null reset is not the increment operand. General calendar parameter/runtime validation remains separate.
Increment/decrement branch requires non-null state; disabled checker sentinel initializes to integer zero; returning to null skips arithmetic.
Null MAX result becomes integer zero; increment is in the non-null alternative or established set advancement. Database type/workflow acceptance remains separate.
Null display placeholder is overwritten with year arithmetic before either decrement.
Null foreach sentinel is not decremented; reverse loop resets i from count(array)-1 before --i. Other filter behavior is outside this review.
Textual shortlist false positive caused by a comment separator preceding the variable name. Token inventory finds no increment/decrement in the file.

limitations: The 1,819 tokens are inventoried, not all individually type-proven.
Only the null/boolean/string initialization shortlist above has dispositions.
Array/property increments, external/computed inputs, generated code and full workflow reachability remain open.
